lines: All secret seeds in the secret seed menu now feature descriptions, but don't read them, it's a secret!
Added Classic Crafting Window back through a toggle. Right click on the Crafting Window button to toggle which window will appear. This selection is saved in settings as well.
Added "Pause When Unfocused" setting. Disabling this allows singleplayer sessions to continue playing while focusing on other applications.
Added a Dash Keybinding (default unbound), and a "Double Tap Dashing" toggle.
Added an Armor Set Ability Keybinding (default unbound).
Added Next Loadout and Previous Loadout Keybindings (default unbound). These cycle through all loadouts, and can help on gamepad.
Invisibility Potion's effect now fully hides the player again, as it did in 1.4.4.9.
Gem Critters now appear underground regardless of ongoing festivities.
Dedicated Server world creation menu no longer prompts for special seeds after entering a copied seed code.
Mannequins can now display Minecarts.
Added Bluesky to Terraria's main menu links.
Gravedigger Shovel now works on all cloud types.
Underground Hallow in Remix can now spawn all Hallowed enemies, as intended.
Party Bunnies now become Faelings when shimmered.
Fixed crash when Shadow Beam, Heat Ray, and Magnet Sphere hit certain slopes.
Fixed certain worlds having abnormally endless rain even if they did not bring a towel.
Fixed Chippy's Wings missing its 12 Hallowed Bars recipe requirement.
Fixed Journey trash slot items not being researched when a new fully researchable item is put over them.
Fixed players not ascending past Biome Planter Boxes when holding the up key.
Fixed abnormally low chance of Ghosts appearing from breaking tombstones in higher difficulties.
Fixed an exploit that allowed Superheated Blood's Lava Shark to burst into space.
Fixed drill use sounds getting cut off when Digtoise is digging nearby.
Fixed Finches position with Enchanted Pixie Dust's transformation.
Fixed Enchanted Pixie Dust's transformation position with Yoraiz0r's Spell.
Fixed certain lights disappearing when the game is paused.
Fixed unfortunate meteors landing on sky islands.
Fixed an exploit involving fast mining speed and weapons that emit projectiles, again!
Fixed an exploit involving fast mining speed and item duplication.
Fixed asymmetrical player placement range when against the edges of a block.
Fixed Transformation Mount's placement of Angel Halo.
Fixed certain visual frames of the Fallen Star Block.
Fixed Phasesabers getting stuck when thrown outside the world.
